app_identity.os: Microsoft Windows 11 家庭版 中文版 10.0.26200

media.visible_result: 未登录的登录页：标题「企业账号登录」，左侧品牌区「XCAGI 企业版 / 智能企业管理平台 / 让 AI 驱动的业务增长」；账号框占位文字「XCAGI 账号或邮箱」、密码框占位文字「密码」，两者均为空；主按钮「登 录 →」为浅蓝禁用态；右上角「注册账号」；底部「忘记账号 / 忘记密码 / 帮助」。
登录后的工作台：主区标题「智能对话」，其下账号名「SUNBIRD」；左侧为完整导航（智能对话、考勤工作区、信息、智能生态、知识库、数据对接中心、员工工作台、饰品包装管理、原材料仓库、库存管理、客户管理、订单管理、出货记录、数据来源、包装标签打印、XCAGI modstore、系统设置）；左下状态条显示「系统正常」，其下为版本号 1.0.0.5；登录页的账号/密码输入框已消失。

应用进程被结束并重新启动后，画面仍是已登录工作台：账号「SUNBIRD」、左侧同一套导航、主区「智能对话」，会话未丢失。同一时刻的异常观察：左下状态条由重启前的「系统正常」变为「部分服务异常」；随后直接查询后端 /api/health 返回 status=healthy、runtime.blockers 与 degraded_reasons 均为空，本轮未能定位该条 UI 提示的成因，按实际所见原样记录（见 log/operator-observations.txt）。
在工作台执行「退出登录」，确认框原文「确认 确定退出本机账号？」，点击「确定」后回到登录页：标题「企业账号登录」，账号与密码输入框为空，主按钮「登 录 →」为禁用态，工作台导航与账号名已消失。
整屏录屏 18:15:53–18:16:52（约 59s）：起始画面为已登录工作台（账号 SUNBIRD、智能对话、左侧导航）；随后应用进程被结束、窗口消失只余桌面；接着应用重新启动并显示启动页「XCAGI 企业版 / 正在启动本地服务… 启动进度 9%」；启动完成后回到仍为已登录的工作台。重启后左下角状态条显示「部分服务异常」。

cases.title: no-session rejection
cases.input: No session cookie: GET /api/auth/me and GET /api/auth/session/validate; plus the current GUI state.
cases.actions: Call both protected endpoints without a Cookie header, then read the rendered UI state.
cases.expected: Both endpoints report valid=false, and the window stays on the login page (no workspace).
cases.note: no session cookie -> protected endpoints report valid=false

cases.title: enterprise login (API side)
cases.actions: Login, keep the returned session_id cookie, then GET /api/auth/me with that cookie.
cases.expected: login returns 200 with success=true, a session_id cookie is issued, and me reports success=true with account_kind=enterprise.
cases.note: GUI login evidence (shot/video) is produced by the operator

cases.title: session persistence (process restart)
cases.input: The session cookie obtained in W2, reused after killing and restarting the XCAGI processes.
cases.actions: Close the app, wait for the backend to stop, start XCAGI.exe again, wait for health, then call me + session/validate with the same cookie.
cases.expected: Backend health is 200 and the same session is still valid (me.success=true, validate.valid=true).

cases.title: secure logout
cases.input: An authenticated session cookie; POST /api/auth/logout followed by reuse of that cookie.
cases.actions: Confirm me succeeds before logout, POST /api/auth/logout, then call me + session/validate with the old cookie.
cases.expected: Logout returns 200 and the old cookie is rejected right after (both responses report valid=false).

cases.title: web shares the account system
cases.input: The same enterprise account against the market (Web) endpoint https://xiu-ci.com/api/auth/login.
cases.actions: POST username/password to the market login endpoint and read ok / access_token.
cases.expected: ok=true or an access_token is issued, proving the desktop and Web share one account system.
cases.note: the same enterprise account also logs in on the market (Web) endpoint
